svg.text: The condition-free model in detail: views, residual graphs, network, losses, test
Formulas as in the code on 2026-10-26 (claim-test graphs, model-sheet trainer, current recipe: no own-caption terms, teacher weight 0.25). All embeddings and outputs are unit vectors; τ = 0.05.

1 Views: six Qwen embeddings per painting p, from one frozen embedder
painting p
its captions (example text)
“a calm lake at dusk”
“lonely and quiet”
“soft evening light”
Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B
frozen; one pass per view
the system prompt makes the view
default: “Represent the user’s input”
emotion: “Represent the emotion of this artwork, or of this description
of an artwork. Focus only on the emotion.”
style, genre: “Describe the <aspect> of this artwork in one word”
six views
default view: the network’s input
xp = Qwen(imagep )
cp = norm( meank Qwen(captionp,k ) ): the painting mean
instructed images: the teacher targets; the style and genre graphs
temo p = Qwenemo (imagep )
tsty p = Qwensty (imagep )
tgen p = Qwengen (imagep )
instructed captions: the emotion graph
ep = norm( meank Qwenemo (captionp,k ) )
why the mean, why the instruction
a painting has several captions by different viewers; their mean embedding is one caption
vector per painting, so images and captions pair one to one. An instruction changes which
paintings Qwen places near each other: on 5,000 development paintings the emotion instruction
raised emotion AMI from 0.0696 to 0.0929 (image side), the style instruction raised style AMI
from 0.2217 to 0.3952, and each lowered most other-aspect AMIs (stage report, step 2).
Qwen never trains; the model learns these geometries from the default view alone.
2 Buddy graphs: one per aspect, built on the training paintings only, no labels
scaled similarity in a space V: simV (i, j) = cos(vi , vj ) / sdV , sdV = std of cos over 200,000 random pairs (seed 0)
content(i, j) = ½ [ simD (i, j) + simI (i, j) ] D: the default caption means c, I: the default images x
emotion score(i, j) = simE (i, j) − λi · content(i, j) E: the emotion caption means e
style score(i, j) = simS (i, j) − 0.5 · content(i, j) S: the style-instructed images tsty
genre score(i, j) = cos(tgen i , tgen j ) nothing subtracted
λi = | plain emotion buddies of i ∩ content buddies of i | / | plain emotion buddies of i |
plain emotion buddies: mutual top-20 in E alone; content buddies: mutual top-20 in D or in I;
a painting with no plain emotion buddy gets the mean λ. Example at right: 2 of 4, so λi = 0.5 and half
of content(i, j) is subtracted from every score of anchor i.
from scores to a graph, per aspect
for each anchor i, the 20 highest scores (self excluded);
keep the pair (i, j) only if each is in the other’s 20 (mutual);
every kept pair has weight 1
what the subtraction does
a content twin of i (same scene, little emotion in common) loses
score and drops out of the top-20; an emotion twin with a different
scene gains and comes in. The weight λ of i is large when its emotion
neighbours are mostly content neighbours, so the subtraction is
strongest where emotion and content coincide.

3 The network: two sides; a first layer shared by the aspects, a second layer per aspect
image side: h = GELU( W1 xp ), dropout 0.1; za img (p) = norm( Wa 2 h ), a ∈ {emotion, style, genre}
caption side: the same shape on cp with its own weights W′1 , W′a 2 ; the sides share nothing
W1 : 2048 × 1024, one per side, shared by the three aspects; Wa 2 : 1024 × 2048, one per aspect and side
parameters: 8.4 M per side, 16.8 M in all; three separate two-layer MLPs per side would be 25.2 M (not chosen, step 12)

W₁ is updated by every aspect’s loss; each W₂ only by its own aspect’s
another image encoder as the student’s input
xp comes from SigLIP, CLIP or DINOv2 instead of Qwen; only W1 changes its input width (SigLIP 2: 1,152;
CLIP B/32: 512; DINOv2-large: 1,024). The caption side, the graphs and the teacher targets stay Qwen’s.
4 The losses, for one aspect a and one batch of B = 512 buddy pairs (i, j) from a’s graph
InfoNCE between two lists of outputs uk , vk (k = 1 … B):
NCE(u, v) = ½ meank [ −log softmaxl ( uk ·vl / τ )k − log softmaxl ( vk ·ul / τ )k ]
the k-th pair is the positive; the other B − 1 paintings of the batch are the negatives

(4 of the 512 pairs drawn)
buddy loss, 4/5 of the weight (both sides, cross pairs included)
La buddy = ¼ [ NCE(zimg (i), zimg (j)) + NCE(zimg (i), zcap (j))
+ NCE(zcap (i), zimg (j)) + NCE(zcap (i), zcap (j)) ]
a painting’s outputs move toward its buddy’s, away from the batch’s others
teacher loss, 1/5 of the weight (image side only; direct distillation)
La teach = meann −log softmaxm ( za img (pn ) · ta p_m / τ )n
over the 2B paintings of the batch (both endpoints of every pair);
the same painting is masked out of the negatives
stopping, per aspect
after each epoch: La on the stopping
paintings’ pairs (6,152 paintings),
no labels; a new minimum saves the
heads and the trunk; stop after
15 epochs without one
La = La buddy + 0.25 · La teach ; one batch per aspect per step, the three aspects in turn
own-caption terms, ½ [ NCE(zimg (i), zcap (i)) + NCE(zimg (j), zcap (j)) ], have weight 0 in the current recipe
settings: AdamW, learning rate 1e-3, weight decay 0.05, batch 512, at most 200 epochs, patience 15
5 Test time: one default-image pass, k-means per aspect, AMI against the labels

emotion: the mode of the caption labels of the painting (nine ArtELingo emotions); style and genre: WikiArt’s.
held set: 12,281 ArtELingo paintings, read with 5 model seeds; development: 29,232 fresh paintings.
an instruction-free pass: no caption, no prompt, no PercepT topic classifier at test time.
where it stands (held emotion AMI, 2026-10-26)
ours, Qwen input: 0.1029; SigLIP 1: 0.1036; SigLIP 2: 0.1024; CLIP L/14: 0.0996 (passes)
bar: PercepT core’s own reading on the Qwen image, 0.0874; a pass needs +0.0100 with the interval above zero
CLIP B/16 (0.0945) and B/32 (0.0885) inconclusive; DINOv2-large fails. Style and genre: development data only.
